properties.name: Nagapattinam coast: Vedaranyam swamp and Point Calimere
properties.why: Southern Cauvery delta coast in Nagapattinam district: tidal mudflats, the Great Vedaranyam Swamp, Point Calimere wetlands and adjoining agricultural fields. ISRO's NISAR S-band GCOV release shows a Nagapattinam scene (2 July 2026) with mangroves, fields, wetlands and coastal lagoons. PROPOSED analyst AOI: verify it lies inside the footprint of a passing scene pair and shrink it to that footprint before analysis.
